rules.title: OCI MySQL replica stopped
rules.expr: (1 - min by (environment, host) (laimory_oci_mysql_replica_running{environment="prod",host="oci-prod"})) + ((time() - max by (environment, host) (laimory_oci_mysql_replica_last_collect_unixtime_seconds{environment="prod",host="oci-prod"})) > bool 300)
rules.summary: OCI MySQL replica IO or SQL thread is not running, or the replica status collector has stopped.
rules.description: Run SHOW REPLICA STATUS in the OCI mysql container (Last_IO_Error, Last_SQL_Error) and check laimory-oci-mysql-replica-status.timer. A disconnected IO thread retries on its own; this fires only after 5 minutes.

rules.title: OCI MySQL replica lag high
rules.summary: OCI MySQL replica is more than 5 minutes behind prod.
rules.description: Check the Tailscale path to prod MySQL and the replica SQL thread. -1 (unknown) does not trigger this rule; a stopped thread is covered by the replica stopped rule.

rules.title: OCI MySQL dump backup stale
rules.summary: OCI MySQL logical dump has not succeeded in over 26 hours.
rules.description: Inspect laimory-oci-mysqldump-backup.service logs, the R2 token, and the backup account on the OCI host.

rules.title: OCI MySQL binlog upload stale
rules.summary: OCI MySQL binlog upload to R2 has not succeeded in over 10 minutes.
rules.description: The off-host copy is falling behind. Inspect laimory-oci-binlog-upload.service logs and the R2 token on the OCI host.

rules.title: OCI API down
rules.summary: Alloy cannot scrape the OCI api container (api:9090).
rules.description: Check docker compose ps api and the api logs on the OCI host. No data (Alloy or the host is down) also fires this rule.

rules.title: OCI AI health check failed
rules.summary: The OCI ai container does not answer /health.
rules.description: Check docker compose ps ai and the ai logs on the OCI host. Timeline generation fails while this fires.

rules.title: api.laimory.app HTTPS probe failed
rules.summary: Synthetic Monitoring cannot get a healthy /readyz from https://api.laimory.app (Seoul probe).
rules.description: readyz includes the database and Redis. Check nginx, the certificate, DNS, and the api readiness on the OCI host.

rules.title: api.laimory.app TLS certificate expires within 30 days
rules.summary: The api.laimory.app certificate expires within 30 days.
rules.description: Certbot renews twice a day on the OCI host (laimory-cert-renew.timer). Check its logs and the nginx-certs copy hook.

rules.title: api.laimory.app TLS certificate expires within 14 days
rules.summary: The api.laimory.app certificate expires within 14 days.
rules.description: Renewal has been failing for weeks. Run the certbot renewal on the OCI host and reload nginx.

rules.title: OCI API HTTP 5xx ratio high
rules.expr: (sum by (environment, host) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="spring_boot",environment="prod",host="oci-prod",uri!~"/actuator.*|/readyz|/status",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (environment, host) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="spring_boot",environment="prod",host="oci-prod",uri!~"/actuator.*|/readyz|/status"}[5m])), 1)) and on (environment, host) (sum by (environment, host) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="spring_boot",environment="prod",host="oci-prod",uri!~"/actuator.*|/readyz|/status"}[5m])) >= 20)
rules.summary: More than 5% of OCI API requests returned 5xx over 5 minutes (at least 20 requests).
rules.description: Inspect the api logs on the OCI host for the failing paths and exception types.

rules.title: OCI API HTTP p95 latency high
rules.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, environment, host) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job="spring_boot",environment="prod",host="oci-prod",uri!~"/actuator.*|/readyz|/status"}[5m])))) and on (environment, host) (sum by (environment, host) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="spring_boot",environment="prod",host="oci-prod",uri!~"/actuator.*|/readyz|/status"}[5m])) >= 20)
rules.summary: OCI API p95 latency has been above 1 second for 10 minutes.
rules.description: Check database latency on the Tailscale path, Hikari pool usage, and host CPU on the OCI host.

rules.title: OCI API JVM heap pressure
rules.expr: sum by (environment, host) (jvm_memory_used_bytes{job="spring_boot",environment="prod",host="oci-prod",area="heap"}) / clamp_min(sum by (environment, host) (jvm_memory_max_bytes{job="spring_boot",environment="prod",host="oci-prod",area="heap"} > 0), 1)
rules.summary: OCI API heap usage has been above 85% for 10 minutes.
rules.description: Look for GC pressure in the api logs. The heap ceiling is the JVM default (25% of host memory) unless -Xmx is set.

rules.title: OCI API Hikari connection pool pressure
rules.expr: (max by (environment, host) (hikaricp_connections_active{job="spring_boot",environment="prod",host="oci-prod"}) / clamp_min(max by (environment, host) (hikaricp_connections_max{job="spring_boot",environment="prod",host="oci-prod"}), 1)) and on (environment, host) (max by (environment, host) (hikaricp_connections_pending{job="spring_boot",environment="prod",host="oci-prod"}) > 0)
rules.summary: OCI API Hikari pool is over 90% used with waiting threads for 5 minutes.
rules.description: Check slow queries and the database round trip time from the OCI host.

rules.title: OCI host memory low
rules.expr: max by (environment, host) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node",environment="prod",host="oci-prod"}) / max by (environment, host) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node",environment="prod",host="oci-prod"})
rules.summary: OCI host available memory has been below 15% for 10 minutes.
rules.description: The host has no swap. Check docker stats for api, ai, mysql, nginx, and alloy.

rules.title: OCI host filesystem space low
rules.expr: max by (environment, host, mountpoint) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node",environment="prod",host="oci-prod"}) / max by (environment, host, mountpoint) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node",environment="prod",host="oci-prod"})
rules.summary: An OCI host filesystem has less than 20% free space.
rules.description: Check MySQL datadir and binlog size, Docker images, and logs on the OCI host.

rules.title: OCI host OOM kill detected
rules.summary: The kernel OOM killer terminated a process on the OCI host.
rules.description: Find the killed process in the kernel log (journalctl -k) and check which container restarted.
